### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials
- Problems: P3a post missing ride credit (trip 33923696); P3b book credit correction (trip 5dd0097b); P2 window refund of the 2026-09-20 period fee; P0 (root) All Access move-up. Edges: P0 → P2; P2 → P3a; P2 → P3b. Order: {P3a, P3b} → P2 → P0.
- Hop P0→P2 — **state-derived**. Sentence (All Access tool card): "The All Access upgrade charge is not fixed until a period fee still inside its full refund window carries the refund owed on it." Records: 199.00 charge dated 09-20, 21 days old, no refund naming it. Search "period fee refund full refund window" → window refund tool card: "the member … moves up to the Wayfare Pass All Access Annual plan"; "The window refund is booked against the fee charge that paid the period in force and names that charge" (the depended-on rule's own trigger, which states which events qualify for the refund).
- Hop P2→P3a — **state-derived**. Sentence: "The window refund is fixed only after every eligible trip completed in that period whose credit has fallen due carries its ride credit entry." Records: trip 33923696 completed 10-06 with no `pass_credit_earn`. Search "ride credit entry" → posting tool card: "The credit earn entry is the trip's ride credit entry on the membership ledger"; before/after "A completed trip whose credit has fallen due shows no credit earn entry".
- Hop P2→P3b — **state-derived**. Sentence: "The window refund is not worked out before every fare of that period reduced by a fare adjustment carries the credit correction owed on it." Records: adjustment e9292bc0 on fare 3d982a8c; no forfeiture names earn 4fa252ce. Search "credit correction fare adjustment" → corrections tool card: "the credit correction owed is booked as a credit forfeiture of the trip-refund kind that names the credit earn entry it corrects".
- No hop was handed over by another problem's tool name, route or aggregated chain.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the one thing asked" (hand over the upgrade with 249 − 199×344/365 = 61.45): excluded — the charge "is not fixed until a period fee still inside its full refund window carries the refund owed on it", and the refund itself "is fixed only after" the missing credit entry and "not worked out before" the correction.
- Closest alternatives: pro-rata cancellation refund (cancellation term 3) — not applicable, the member is not ending the membership; refund outside the window — excluded, 21 days ≤ 30; former terms A/B (benefit use voids the full refund) — retired in cancellation_and_fee_refunds, but the schedule doc's column meaning still reads "…and no benefit was used since that charge" (a visible inconsistency; the hub and the retired-terms block resolve it in favour of the refund) — flagged for the scan; eligible fare from the recalculated 44.90 (excluded by the route-changed first case); clawback base 37.05 vs the eligible-fare factor (trip 5dd0097b has no route change, both agree).
